description: Sera in a candidate GUARD class outfit. Same brown eyes, face, high ponytail with blue ribbon and body proportions as the attached Sera references. Heavy plate armor, a large functional shield and a thick longsword. Silver steel, blue and a little gold; feet planted to protect the front. No light armor or decorative tiny shield.
mustKeep: The character must be exactly the same size as in the attached size reference (the standing idle frame): same head size and same height when standing upright
Keep the same face and body proportions as Sera; this is a costume candidate, not a new character or a final approved design. No cape in these first-class candidates.
